description: Central registry for named editor commands. Owns the forced-disable stack and read-only gating.

members.name: AddForceDisableReason
members.description: Adds a forced-disable reason for the named command. The command stays disabled until all reasons are removed.

members.name: ExecuteAsync
members.description: Executes a command only when the current command state is visible and enabled.

members.name: GetRequired
members.description: Returns a registered command by name. Throws when not found.

members.name: GetState
members.description: Returns the last computed state for the named command, or null when not yet refreshed.

members.name: RefreshAllAsync
members.description: Recomputes and caches the state of every registered command against the given context.

members.name: Register
members.description: Registers a command. Throws if a command with the same name is already registered.

members.name: RemoveForceDisableReason
members.description: Removes a previously added forced-disable reason. The command becomes eligible for re-enabling once no reasons remain.

members.name: TryGet
members.description: Tries to find a registered command by name. Returns false when not found.
